cards.headline: Bentley Continental GT: Red warning back with beeping; driver reports A7 stop, no recovery
cards.whatHappened: The red warning came back, now beeping, when the driver restarted the car, and the engine is off again at a service area the driver names on the A7. Nothing is booked for recovery while the customer's service decision is pending (Shift lead owns it), and today's Hamburg delivery will be late.

findings.text: The driver wrote at 11:00 CEST that the red warning came back when they started the engine to move the car away from the entrance, that it now beeps, and that they switched it off again.

The driver wrote at 11:02 CEST that they are safe, standing outside the car away from traffic with the hazards on, at Hollenmark services on the A7 northbound about 40 km south of Hannover, and that they have just sent the dashboard photo in the app.
The customer asked at 10:40 CEST to keep the car stopped while their service contact decides between roadside assistance and collection.
At 10:31 CEST the Shift lead noted that nothing is booked for recovery yet and that a person must call the customer for instructions.

Kellerbrook Recovery is 9 km from the place the driver described and can send a tow truck in about 52 min. Their quotes are about €215 to tow the car to their workshop and about €810 to tow it to the Hamburg delivery address (quotes only, nothing booked).
The customer was promised delivery in Hamburg on Wed 21 Oct between 12:00 and 16:00 CEST.
The last GPS reading, at 07:00 CEST, showed 233 km to go and is now 4 hours old.
